verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents Live Events as a real-time debugger view showing function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results, and dead-lettered events per destination, exportable to external monitoring stacks, plus dedicated dead-letter/reprocessing worker and real-time Email/Slack alerting on Connector Sync or Warehouse Batch job failure/recovery. This directly matches the story's ask for live event visibility, per-destination delivery diagnostics, and alerting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the debugger UI's usability and no explicit mention of per-destination delivery latency metrics dashboards beyond batch/streaming status.
